name: WizardTemplate
need: The wizard archetype was the taxonomy's only entry with no carrier at all: one app's call wrap-up built a 4-step stepper flow by hand, Stellar (outside the monorepo) built a 15-step flow engine, RADAR built a modal wizard — three independent hand-rollings of one shape, and the DS had a Stepper atom with no page to live on.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: Presentational by design: it shows progress but carries no page, no Back/Next contract, no review step. Every hand-rolled wizard already used it and still rebuilt the rest.
A wizard is a PAGE with revealed steps and a check-answers contract; a modal form is one surface submitted once.
Three products composed it three different ways; the fourth would invent a fourth.

proposedApi.WizardTemplate: title, steps (3-5; a 2-step wizard is a form with extra clicks), current + onStep (parent-owned, URL-mirrored), backLabel/nextLabel (plain Next — steps are freely navigable, one app's lesson), submitLabel naming the real event, onSubmit, busy. No Cancel on purpose: leaving belongs to the screen's chrome, and the live case never had one.
proposedApi.WizardReview + WizardReviewRow: the check-answers step (GOV.UK): label/value rows in flow order, Change links that jump back to their step, accessible names carrying the field, empty optionals reading 'Not provided'

sources: one app ActiveCallPage wrap-up (live case: free navigation, plain Next), Cloudscape multipage create (review mirrors flow order, bottom action row), GOV.UK check answers (round-trip edit contract)
decision: Build as a block per the golden-screens G3 batch. The wizard archetype gains its carrier in the taxonomy. One app's wrap-up stays as is — it is a live-tool hybrid inside its own repo, and its spec belongs to a future one app spec-corpus pass, not to this block's landing.
